items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And I played in the orchestra that was on the program.

ctx.x: And I played in the orchestra that was on the program. At that time I had developed enough to play in the orchestra. That played.

Can you tell me some of your favorite musicians that you've heard? I'm not trying to put you on the spot, because I know that you're in your... Well, there's so many. There's so many. I have... I mean some of the old timers maybe that aren't even living now on different instruments that you've liked.
